'''Scentwood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] that furniture was constructed from. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Klaus Vandangante/Legends|Doc Vandangante]] had a large, hand-carved desk made from scentwood on his [[Sarlucif|outlaw techs' base of operations]].
